name: PA-05
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strong Democratic district with a +15 partisan lean
Scanlon is a well-funded incumbent; challenger raised under $10,000
Prediction markets price a Democratic win at 98%
model.rationale: The +15 district lean, Scanlon's roughly 100-to-1 fundraising advantage, and Polymarket's 98% pricing all point to a comfortable incumbent win, so the fundamentals-based margin of about 23 points stands.
model.watch: A major late outside-spending intervention on the challenger's behalf is the only realistic path to narrowing this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Incumbent Mary Gay Scanlon (D) is running.

overview:
Mary Gay Scanlon seeks another term in a Delaware County-area district that leans about 15 points Democratic. She has raised nearly $1 million and holds a large cash advantage, while Republican Nicholas Manganaro has raised under $10,000 and has no visible outside support. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give Scanlon roughly a 98% chance of winning.

With no competitive spending against her and the district's strong partisan tilt, the race is rated Safe Democratic, with an expected margin in the low 20s and moderate uncertainty given the absence of polling.
